subject: Bullying Prevention and Intervention Plan Revision
overview: The subcommittee reviewed the district's bullying prevention and intervention plan to address concerns regarding document accessibility, investigation consistency, and parent education. Discussions focused on streamlining the 38-page document and proposed a new framework to separate high-level committee policy from administrative implementation plans.

items.title: Bullying Prevention and Intervention Plan Review
items.summary: The subcommittee began a review of the existing bullying prevention document to remove redundancies and ensure consistent terminology throughout.

items.title: Public Feedback and Investigation Consistency
items.summary: Public testimony highlighted concerns that required bullying investigations and incident report forms were not consistently utilized in the past, prompting requests for better transparency.

items.title: Resource Development and Parent Training
items.summary: Members recommended creating visual flowcharts of the reporting process, providing translated materials, and conducting parent education sessions to distinguish between conflict and bullying.

items.title: District Proactive Measures and Support Programs
items.summary: Staff presented proactive measures currently in use, such as Responsive Classroom and the Nexus program, alongside the upcoming implementation of the 'Say Something' anonymous reporting tool.

items.title: Policy vs. Plan Procedural Framework
items.summary: The committee discussed bifurcating the requirements into a high-level School Committee policy and a detailed administrative implementation plan to clarify the body's oversight role.
